title: AS2: 'undefined' keyword literal compiles to null (type 2) not undefined (type 3)
description: FIXED. Root cause: parser.ts parsePrimary intercepted the 'undefined' keyword and returned Literal{value:null,raw:'undefined'}, so compileLiteral pushed ActionPush type 2 (null) instead of type 3 (undefined) — breaking ===/typeof/return undefined in AVM1 (null!=undefined for strict eq). Fix: parser now returns Identifier{name:'undefined'}, routing through compileIdentifier's pushUndefined() (ActionPush type 3). compileIdentifier (line 1745) and scanExpr (line 267, no string-pool add) already fully supported this. Acceptance test: packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/undefined-keyword.test.ts (6 cases) decodes ActionPush type tags: 'var x=undefined' pushes type 3 not 2; 'x===undefined' pushes type 3 + StrictEquals 0x66; 'return undefined' type 3; 'typeof undefined' type 3 + ActionTypeOf 0x44; 'null' still type 2 (no regression); undefined-as-arg type 3. Build: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build exit 0. Tests: pnpm --filter @flash/core test = 5633 passed | 8 skipped (incl. the 6 new).
